meaning: 你这周末有什么安排吗
usageNote: 超日常的周末约人句！语气随意友好，想约朋友出去玩就用这句，比'Do you have plans'更英式口语～

examples.en: Have you got any plans this weekend? We're thinking of going hiking!
examples.zh: 你这周末有安排吗？我们打算去爬山！

examples.en: Hey, have you got any plans this weekend, or are you free to hang out?
examples.zh: 嘿，你周末有安排吗，还是有空出来玩？
